about: Cycle 0 round 8 (operator ruling 6): the brand fit corpus. Real long titles from the design board's runs (the lines the second palette refused in round 7, and the longest ruled forms), each with the surface it is set on. brand_system.validate_display sets every one in the brand's display face on its surface's measure at that surface's ladder floor (FIT_SPECS); a brand whose face cannot is refused when it is configured, never run by run in production.
